script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet of earth element, forms a powerful sextile to Mars in your 10th House of Career and Public Image, igniting ambition and visibility. Meanwhile, the Moon in Scorpio squares Saturn in your 8th House of Shared Resources, creating friction around joint finances and emotional intimacy. In love, if you're taken, expect your partner to withdraw slightly under that Saturn square—don't force connection today. If single, the Venus-Mars sextile attracts a disciplined earth-sign admirer who values stability and long-term commitment. Career-wise, this is an excellent day to pitch a long-term project or ask for a raise, but avoid signing legal documents while the Moon-Saturn square is active. Mercury in your 2nd House of Income supports practical financial planning. One warning: do not lend money to a friend today. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
